meta.title: GOLD
meta.reviewSession: arena-88aa65fd late-evening re-verification on base records built by earlier sessions
meta.scope: 44 unique named product pages across 13 retailers verified through 2026-10-23 UTC, covering all root-register and companion-dashboard listings without duplication.
meta.pricePolicy: No hallucinations: never invent prices, specifications, or verification. Null means unverified. Prices are dated observations, not live quotes or checkout totals. Source claims are not independent authentication.

marketReference.caveat: Dated dealer reference, not LBMA and not a live feed. The page's own timestamp is 2026-10-23 05:56 EDT. Calculations are conditional illustrations only.

sellers.name: Automic Gold
sellers.summary: U.S. returns: 30 days from delivery; mail within 14 days to avoid the stated recycling fee. Unworn/original condition. Custom, engraved and modified items final sale.
sellers.notes: Exact-size metal mass, paired marks and non-destructive inspection/return permission remain unconfirmed.

sellers.name: Catbird
sellers.summary: Domestic online: 20 days from delivery; $9 return shipping deducted. Unused, authorized return in original packaging. Special orders/engraving final sale. International sales final.
sellers.notes: Do not assume a configured or resized ring is returnable. Fetched specifications were incomplete.

sellers.name: Auvere
sellers.summary: Start within 15 days of delivery; dispatch within 10 days of the return-instructions email. Original unaltered condition and intact tag. Sale/Rare Collection excluded.
sellers.notes: “Fine Weight” definition is unresolved. Stock-size eligibility and independent-testing permission not confirmed.

sellers.name: Quince
sellers.summary: Engagement rings: 60 days from purchase, NOT the generic 365-day delivery window. Made-to-order jewelry: $35 restocking. Original packaging/certificates required; customized items excluded.
sellers.notes: Mixed-metal head/band must not be valued as if all of the ring were 14k gold.

sellers.name: Menē
sellers.summary: Return window not yet confirmed in captured evidence. Crafted-on-Demand weights may vary by up to 1g and final price may be adjusted. Buyback is not a refund.
sellers.notes: Do not substitute weights/prices from recommendation cards for the main product.

sellers.name: Blue Nile
sellers.summary: Eligible original, unworn items: 30 days from shipment; RMA required. Two complimentary returns/year. Engraved, custom and items resized after initial purchase excluded; retain certificates.
sellers.notes: Existing two-setting research retained and directly rechecked. Full-ring price, currency context and independent reputation remain unconfirmed.

sellers.name: Zales
sellers.summary: Product excerpt says free and easy 30-day returns. Standalone policy, clock, resized/custom exclusions and inspection permission are unconfirmed.
sellers.notes: No contact channel or independent reputation check established in this combined review.

sellers.name: VRAI
sellers.summary: Eligible items: 30 days. Engagement-ring recycling fee $300 for original-payment refund; fee waived for store credit. Items above $15,000: store-credit conditions. Modified/resized, third-party-altered and custom items excluded.
sellers.notes: Published withdrawal email only; contact not tested. Ring-size-6 metal-weight claim is not an independent assay.

sellers.name: Brilliant Earth
sellers.summary: Full order-specific return terms not captured in this recheck. Consult the official care/returns hub; do not substitute promotional benefits for eligibility.
sellers.notes: Care hub publishes 800.691.0952; the localized product page displayed 1.415.426.2781. Region/source context differs; no call placed.

sellers.name: Sarraf Jewelry Inc.
sellers.summary: 30 days from delivery; buyer pays insured return shipping; custom/altered excluded; internal policy conflict on engraved returns ($25 removal fee vs non-engraved rule).
sellers.notes: BBB Accredited A+ since 1998 (2.33/5 across 3 customer reviews; 6 complaints/3 yrs). Confirm finger-size gram mass in writing before ordering.

sellers.name: Factory Direct Jewelry
sellers.summary: 30 days from delivery (buyer pays return shipping); 20% restocking fee on altered items; outside jeweler work voids warranty.
sellers.notes: HIGH CAUTION: Not BBB Accredited, 1.8/5 across 5 reviews, 11 complaints in 3 years including ultra-thin band breakage.

sellers.name: Stone and Strand
sellers.summary: 100 days less $12.50 restocking fee on full-price items ONLY; >=50%-off sale items, made-to-order, custom, and engraved rings are strictly non-returnable Final Sale.
sellers.notes: Not BBB Accredited (0 complaints/3 yrs on NYC BBB). Do not purchase Final Sale items without return rights.

sellers.name: Mejuri
sellers.summary: Free 30-day returns from delivery in the US/Canada/UK/Australia/Germany; engraved and monogrammed products are non-returnable; US return shipping free.
sellers.notes: No ISO currency statement was found on the product page, cart endpoint (404) or payment FAQ, so the 'From $2,900' amount stays unassigned (F-025, F-030). Gram weight, hallmark and maker's mark remain unstated.
